positions.title: Test Engineer / Automation
positions.description:
1. Conversion of manual test cases to automated, using tools/languages such as; Perl, Tcl, Expect, Fanfare's iTest, Bash, MySQL, PHP, VBS, and Python.

Automation scripts include interaction with/control of equipment such as; Ixia, Veriwave, Spirent, digital attenuators.

2. Post-processing of data/results with Excel/Perl, including analysis.
